resources.string: Nudge until the thumbnail matches the frame playing behind this panel.
Left/Right adjust · OK resets · Down uses the suggested value · Up or Back closes
Suggested: %1$s (duration gap vs. the preview source)
Makes seek thumbnails from what playback already downloaded, so they always line up and cost no extra data. Seekr fills in the parts you have not watched yet.
Thumbnails for parts you have not watched come from seekr.tv and need your own free key from seekr.tv. Without a key, previews come only from the device.
Paste your seekr.tv key. It is checked with Seekr, then stored encrypted on this TV for this profile. Type clear to remove it.
